Rts.Node.Why: 酒馆本身就是靠它跑起来的
The tavern itself runs on it
Rts.Node.Need: Without it the tavern will not open
Rts.Npm.Why: 给酒馆装零件，也用来装后台工具
Installs parts for the tavern and runs background tools
Rts.Npm.Need: 没有它，零件装不上，酒馆跑不起来
Without it nothing installs and the tavern cannot run
Rts.Git.Why: 下载和更新酒馆代码、装扩展
Downloads and updates tavern code, installs extensions
Rts.Git.Need: 没有它，装不了酒馆，也装不了扩展
Without it you cannot install the tavern or its extensions
Rts.Caddy.Why: 让别人用网址访问你的酒馆时用
Needed when others reach your tavern by URL
Rts.Caddy.Need: 没有它只影响外网访问，自己用不受影响
Without it only outside access is affected; local use is fine
Rts.Pm2.Why: 关掉窗口后还能继续跑
Keeps running after the window closes
Rts.Pm2.Need: 没有它，一关启动器酒馆就停
Without it the tavern stops when the launcher closes
Rts.Desktop.Why: 在启动器里直接开一个窗口
Opens a window inside the launcher
Rts.Desktop.Need: 没有它，会自动改用浏览器打开
Without it the browser is used instead
Rts.Busy: 另一个安装任务正在进行
Rts.SkipAfterNode: Node.js 没装好，后面的先跳过
Node.js is not ready, so the rest is skipped
